scope: One real Q5_K routed-expert sublayer, not a complete MoE/model layer or serving-engine TP implementation
routing_limit: All token rows use the same ten ordered experts; high reuse, no router or dynamic routing benchmark
production_reference: native_expert_grouped with cap_groups=cap_entries=10*T, followed by native_moe_combine_multi; current environment controls production dispatch
decomposed_reference: Full native_mmvq gate/up, native_swiglu_quantize_q8_1, full native_mmvq down, unchanged expert-order native_moe_combine_multi
tp_path: Broadcast original Q8_1 input; GU output rows split on whole 32-value blocks; publish exact hidden Q8_1 blocks into their original positions in portable host memory; allgather hidden; down OUTPUT rows split with the complete K=640 dot; same expert-order combine; allgather final F32 output to every rank
transport: CUDA kernels reading/writing portable pinned host memory, producer events and cross-device cudaStreamWaitEvent, no P2P APIs or NCCL
parity: Exact hidden Q8_1 bytes against decomposed reference
Full combined F32 output bitwise/difference counts/nonfinite/max-absolute/max-relative against decomposed and production references
Zero input and three deterministic nonzero activations by default
Raw-bit allgather check on every rank
timing: All allocations, model reads, warmup and graph capture/upload excluded
Ten warmup rounds and 100 measured rounds by default
Wall time includes submissions, device changes, host traffic and all-rank stream synchronization
Per-rank compute-phase CUDA events exclude host exchange; sum/max are not a critical-path measurement
Standalone allgather per-row payloads 6912,7200,10240,24576,40960 bytes at T=1,2,3,8; event times include waits/copy kernels
Runner records GPU clock/power/temperature samples without modifying clocks
interpretation: A speedup versus decomposed reference alone is insufficient. Non-bitwise production comparisons are reported and prohibit calling the prototype an exact production replacement. The prototype launches separate per-expert GEMVs while production fuses groups; a loss measures this implementation and does not disprove a future fused TP kernel. Prefill and end-to-end engine performance remain unmeasured.
